messages:
Jun Park: pushed changes to #5234 — addressed Maria's feedback about the API surface, added unit tests for the shim, and clarified the public docs. PTAL when you have a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5234

Maria Gomez: thanks. quick q — you changed retry semantics; does that affect deduping? can you show the new header behavior?

Jun Park: good catch. updated code to preserve idempotency header and kept dedupe logic intact. snippet:
```
if (req.headers['x-idempotency']) {
  req.meta.idempotency = req.headers['x-idempotency'];
}
```
added tests in tests/test_retry.py that cover header roundtrip and dedupe.

Maria Gomez: nice. I'll review after stand, should be able to get to it by ~11:30am PT.

CI Bot: build #5234 — tests: 142 passed, 3 skipped — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/proj/5234 (no runtime failures) 

Oliver Chen: are we planning to merge into canary today? we have the 14:00 canary window.

Jun Park: i'd prefer to wait for Maria's LGTM but it's a small change. if Maria is blocked, we can delay a bit.

Emma Li: quick nit — can you add a one-line note to the changelog about the retry semantics change? otherwise LGTM :thumbsup: 

Jun Park: done, changelog updated in the PR.

Maria Gomez: LGTM. left one tiny inline comment about a log message but not blocking.

Emma Li: saw the inline — not blocking for canary. I'll keep an eye on error rates during the canary. :eyes:

Jun Park: thanks all. I'll merge at 14:10 after the canary completes and if CI stays green. ping me here if anything looks off. :rocket:
